entrada.titulo: Secure and trusted data sharing in smart healthcare using blockchain and IoT integration

perfil_anterior.problema: Centralized storage architecture in most IoT healthcare systems can lead to a single point of failure and easy manipulation.
perfil_anterior.solucao: This paper proposes a robust and scalable healthcare architecture using Blockchain smart contracts and IoT, with the integration of the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS).
perfil_anterior.avaliacao: The results show that public healthcare systems based on the Blockchain considerably boost efficiency and performance by integrating IPFS.
perfil_anterior.possibilidades: Investigar a integração de identidade auto-soberana (SSI) para controle de acesso pelos pacientes; aplicar criptografia baseada em atributos (ABE) para compartilhamento granular de dados; testar a arquitetura em múltiplas cidades inteligentes com edge computing; analisar mecanismos de revogação cross‑organizacional; avaliar a escalabilidade em cenários de grande volume de dispositivos IoT.

Unfortunately, privacy and security of personal health information are less reliably pro -
tected in IoT healthcare systems [ 3, 4]. Some inexpensive IoT devices used in IoT sys -
tems are very easy targets for malicious nodes. Due to IoT infrastructure storage and 
memory limits, the healthcare system occasionally stops working when a vast volume 
of healthcare data is collected from many linked sensor devices [ 5]. Despite cloud, edge, 
fog, and mist computing systems offering almost endless storage and processing capac -
ity, healthcare data exchanges’ traffic, bandwidth, and processing latency cause the 
network bottleneck. IoT-based healthcare technology faces substantial performance, 
reliability, scalability, interoperability, privacy, trust, decentralization, and security 
challenges [ 6]. Blockchain with IoT integration can help healthcare systems overcome 
centralized communication architecture and cloud-enabled IoT infrastructures. Most 
healthcare organizations adopt Blockchain, a modern digital ledger technology (DLT), to 
solve technical issues when creating IoT healthcare systems. Blockchain’s peer-to-peer 
network performs cryptographically hashed, immutable transactions on a decentral -
ized architecture [ 7, 8]. Blockchain technology allows data transfers without a central 
authority, eliminating a single point of failure in IoT healthcare systems. Due to Block -
chain technology’s distributed computation and decentralized storage, large-scale device 
connectivity, massive data collection, processing, control, communication, storage, and 
analysis are now more feasible than in conventional healthcare systems [ 9, 10]. Block-
chain technology allows doctors, patients, diagnostic centres, and healthcare workers to 
deliver remote patient care, lower treatment costs, and improve patient care. There are 
three distinct types of Blockchains: public, private, and consortium. Blockchains have 
different access mechanisms and verification procedures, which help to strengthen the 
Blockchain-enabled healthcare system. Proof of work is used to verify the creation of 
new blocks in Blockchain technology [ 5, 11]. Ethereum smart contract automatically 
executes healthcare regulations, policies, and the device registration process when large-
scale healthcare devices are connected to the system. The third-party verification pro -
cess is eliminated with this process. With Blockchain-integrated IoT healthcare systems, 
data tampering, malicious activity, and unsecured devices can be easily identified and 
traced. Blockchain-based healthcare solutions simplify the management of current and 
historical medical records through its decentralized nature. Blockchain technology guar-
antees the confidentiality, security, dependability, and integrity of sensitive healthcare 
information [12, 13]. While Blockchain healthcare has several advantages over conven -
tional healthcare systems, the growing complexity of managing an increasing number 
of devices and their associated data makes it more time-consuming to access, process, 
and analyze this information [ 14]. The Interplanetary File System (IPFS), which stores 
data whose hash value is accessible on Blockchain networks, can be used to reduce 
the overload in Blockchain networks. A decentralized, secure, and irreversible health -
care platform has been the primary focus of most earlier research. The Blockchain net -
work has scalability, speed, and security issues when dealing with massive amounts of 
data collected, processed, and stored using large-scale devices. Therefore, IPFS solves 
this problem and makes a scalable healthcare platform. To store the massive amounts 
of healthcare data generated by networked sensor devices, a Blockchain network is 
coupled with the decentralized file-sharing platform IPFS. To obtain the data we need,

resposta.resumo: O trecho destaca que a privacidade e a segurança das informações de saúde em sistemas IoT são pouco protegidas, que dispositivos baratos são alvos fáceis e que a arquitetura centralizada gera gargalos de rede. Propõe blockchain integrado ao IoT e ao IPFS para eliminar ponto único de falha, melhorar escalabilidade e garantir integridade dos dados, mas reconhece limitações de desempenho e escalabilidade da própria rede blockchain.
